Ha'il Regional Airport offers a wide range of passenger services to make your arrival in Hail pleasant and convenient.           Explore Hail: Journey Through the Gateway of the Desert

          Uncover the enchanting spirit of Hail, a captivating oasis where historic treasures meet grand desert horizons. Feel the genuine warmth of local hospitality as you venture into a landscape rich with culture and inspiring vistas. From ancient carvings to lively traditional markets, your unforgettable Arabian adventure starts here.


          1. Climb A'arif Fort

          Ascend this historic hilltop stronghold to enjoy stunning panoramic views over the golden desert and cityscape. Walk the ancient paths and feel the timeless defensive heritage come alive. This iconic landmark offers the perfect vantage point to watch the sun glow over the vast northern plains.


          2. Discover Jubbah Rock Art

          Journey to the UNESCO World Heritage site to marvel at ancient carvings depicting ancestral life and wild animals. Thousands of years of human creativity stand etched into the towering sandstone rocks. Read the stories of the past left behind by early travelers in the heart of the desert.


          3. Relax At Samra Park

          Unwind in the city's premier green space featuring scenic lake views nestled dramatically against rugged mountain slopes. Stroll along peaceful walkways or watch the sparkling waters reflect the twilight sky. It is a refreshing sanctuary perfect for families seeking a peaceful moment in nature.


          4. Shop Barzan Souq

          Immerse yourself in the bustling traditional market to find authentic handmade crafts, rich spices, and unique souvenirs. Treat your senses to the lively sights and aromatic scents of local trade. Engage with friendly merchants who carry forward generations of vibrant marketplace traditions.


          5. Tour Faid Historic City

          Step back in time among the fascinating ruins of this ancient desert trade outpost. Explore the remarkable archaeological remnants that once welcomed dusty caravans along historical trails. Discover the critical role this desert fortress played as a vital crossroads of connection and commerce.
